bias.zh: 偏多 · 受制于区间上沿

read.en: Amazon slipped 0.4% on Oct 13 to $258.58 on light volume, after a high of $262.83 stopped short of the Oct 12 top. It sits on its 5-day average ($258.9) and above the 10-day ($255.1), the slightly falling 30 and 100-day ($253.5 and $252.7) and the 200-day ($242.4). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 5, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 2 ($251), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月13日缩量下跌 0.4%，收于 $258.58，盘中高点 $262.83 未能触及 10月12日高点。股价位于 5 日均线（$258.9）附近，并在 10 日（$255.1）、小幅下行的 30 日和 100 日（$253.5 和 $252.7）以及 200 日均线（$242.4）上方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线上方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月2日起看多（$251），RSI 为 54。

read.en: Nothing broke: $263.7, the Oct 12 high and top of the Sep–Oct range, capped the move again. Above it are $267.6 (Aug 28 swing high) and $287.2 (Aug 3 high). Support is $257, tested four times in September, then $253 (30 and 100-day averages) and $248–251 (SAR and range floor). A close above $263.7 would target $267.6.
read.zh: 关键位均未失守：10月12日高点、即 9–10月区间上沿 $263.7 再次压制涨势。其上为 $267.6（8月28日波段高点）和 $287.2（8月3日高点）。支撑为 9月四次测试的 $257，其次 $253（30 日和 100 日均线）及 $248–251（SAR 及区间底部）。若收盘站上 $263.7，目标看 $267.6。

r.en: Oct 12 high, top of the Sep–Oct range
